caption: The drawing depicts a Western-style horse bridle and reins set against a plain, light background. The bridle is primarily composed of brown leather with several silver conchos, circular and rectangular in shape, spaced along the length of the cheekpiece and browband. There are metal elements, including decorative buckles, and a bit situated at the lower end of the bridle, which is attached to the leather with visible stitching. The bit includes a jointed mouthpiece and silver-colored shanks with intricate engraved details. The reins, matching in color to the bridle, are long, split, and also made of brown leather; they are looped and laid out neatly beside the bridle. The leather of the reins is accented with small, faint decorative elements, possibly metal studs or conchos. A double chain curb strap, rendered in grey metallic tones, hangs at the bottom of the bridle beneath the bit. The artist has rendered the textures, shadows, and metallic reflections with attention to detail, accurately representing the materials and construction.
title: Bridle
